counting_notes.method: Semantic allocation of PDF text; excludes references, captions, plot/table text, and formula fragments. Main shares use the 10 non-appendix semantic modules and sum to 1.0; ablation is appendix-only and has zero main share.
counting_notes.formula_rule: Count each visible displayed equation once. Numbered labels include Eq. (1), the two subgroup models (1)/(2), and the fidelity (star) label; unnumbered model displays remain displayed_equation items.

abstract_sentences.text: Human feedback can alter language models in unpredictable and undesirable ways, as practitioners lack a clear understanding of what feedback data encodes.

evidence.anchor: lack a clear understanding of what feedback data encodes

abstract_sentences.text: While prior work studies preferences over certain attributes (e.g., length or sycophancy), automatically extracting relevant features without pre-specifying hypotheses remains challenging.

evidence.anchor: without pre-specifying hypotheses remains challenging

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce What’s In My Human Feedback? (WIMHF), a method to explain feedback data using sparse autoencoders.

evidence.anchor: a method to explain feedback data using sparse autoencoders

abstract_sentences.text: WIMHF characterizes both (1) the preferences a dataset is capable of measuring and (2) the preferences that the annotators actually express.

evidence.anchor: preferences a dataset is capable of measuring

abstract_sentences.text: Across 7 datasets, WIMHF identifies a small number of human-interpretable features that account for the majority of the preference prediction signal achieved by black-box models.

evidence.anchor: account for the majority of the preference prediction signal

abstract_sentences.text: These features reveal a wide diversity in what humans prefer, and the role of dataset-level context: for example, users on Reddit prefer informality and jokes, while annotators in HH-RLHF and PRISM disprefer them.

evidence.anchor: users on Reddit prefer informality and jokes

abstract_sentences.text: WIMHF also surfaces potentially unsafe preferences, such as that LMArena users tend to vote against refusals, often in favor of toxic content.

evidence.anchor: potentially unsafe preferences

abstract_sentences.text: The learned features enable effective data curation: re-labeling the harmful examples in Arena yields large safety gains (+37%) with no cost to general performance.

evidence.anchor: large safety gains (+37%)

abstract_sentences.text: They also allow fine-grained per-personalization: on the Community Alignment dataset, we learn annotator-specific weights over subjective features that improve preference prediction.

evidence.anchor: annotator-specific weights over subjective features

abstract_sentences.text: WIMHF provides a human-centered analysis method for practitioners to better understand and use preference data.

evidence.anchor: better understand and use preference data

abstract_summary.function_order: problem/gap → core idea and method → measurable/expressed distinction → cross-dataset and safety findings → data curation and personalization → impact claim
abstract_summary.strongest_claim_location: Sentence 5 states majority of black-box prediction signal; sentence 8 then gives +37% safety gain.

evidence.anchor: majority of the preference prediction signal achieved by black-box models

introduction_moves.move: context → problem：以 preference data 是 language-model alignment 基础、pairwise labels 进入 preference finetuning 开篇，指出 subjectivity 使 downstream behavior 难以预期。

evidence.anchor: Preference data are the foundation of language model alignment

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work：reward models 能预测哪一响应获胜，却不解释为什么；sycophancy/overconfidence 是后果背景。

evidence.anchor: they do not yield insight as to why

introduction_moves.move: missing_insight：手工指定 politeness、humor 等属性限制发现，反馈中的 idiosyncrasies 需要 data-driven feature discovery。

evidence.anchor: enables automated discovery, from data, of important features

introduction_moves.move: core_idea → method_preview：提出 WIMHF，不预设 hypotheses；SAE 表示 response-pair difference，随后描述并回归 label，区分 measurable 与 expressed preferences。

evidence.anchor: a method to explain preference datasets automatically, without pre-specifying hypotheses

introduction_moves.move: result_preview → scope_boundary：概述七数据集，强调 response generation strategy 影响 style/tone/refusal 与 topic/value diversity，并指出跨数据集 preference conflicts。

evidence.anchor: measurable preferences depend heavily on how responses are generated

introduction_moves.move: result_preview → contribution_list：预览 Arena anti-refusal curation 和 CA annotator-specific personalization，并将可控属性限定为 style 而非 ideology。

evidence.anchor: cleaning examples with the anti-refusal feature

introduction_analysis.chain: 不可预测的 preference data → reward-model 只能预测不能解释 → 手工属性发现不足 → signed SAE feature discovery → fidelity/label regression → context conflicts and safety diagnosis → curation and selective personalization
introduction_analysis.contribution_list_assessment: 贡献预览复用了摘要的大多数结论，但同时给出 84%/67%、+37% 和具体 Arena/CA 干预，因此包含可证伪主张；没有预注册式 hypotheses 或完整限制清单。

evidence.anchor: achieving 84% of the signal that is predictable using dense text embeddings
substantially improves safety (+37%)

related_work_moves.move: nearest_neighbor_contrast：以 Inverse Constitutional AI 为最近邻，比较 prompting/clustering/re-ranking 与 SAE feature discovery，强调 WIMHF 细粒度且能发现 ICAI 漏掉的 unsafe/sustainability patterns。

evidence.anchor: WIMHF tends to discover more specific and granular patterns

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy → limitation_of_prior：按 known-attribute auditing、dataset profiling、reward-model token interpretation 并列，指出多数路线不直接分析训练 reward model 的底层 feedback data。

evidence.anchor: does not analyze the underlying feedback data

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy → gap_creation：按 broad-value datasets、dataset mixing/selection、personalized feedback 三类整理 data-centric preference learning，把 WIMHF 定位为 semantic-feature curation 与可控 personalization。

evidence.anchor: fine-grained semantic features

related_work_moves.move: credit_or_foundation → positioning_only：承认 SAE 的 LLM-interpretability 基础，列出 embedding、clustering、hypothesis-generation 应用后收束到 preference data。

evidence.anchor: using SAEs to build a richer understanding of preference data

related_work_analysis.location: 独立 §6 在 p.10；ICAI 的详细比较延展至 Appendix C.1 p.18–20。
related_work_analysis.repetition_control: 正文不重讲 WIMHF 方法；§6 给出差异，Table 5 在附录承担具体显著数比较。

evidence.anchor: The most comparable method to our work, Inverse Constitutional AI
WIMHF produces more features that statistically significantly predict preference labels

method_moves.move: setup_notation：定义 preference sample `(p,r_A,r_B,y)` 和 prompt/response/label 三因子分布。

evidence.anchor: Pr(p) · Pr(r_A, r_B | p) · Pr(y | r_A, r_B, p)

method_moves.move: state_problem：区分 measurable preferences（response distribution 提供的 axes）与 expressed preferences（能预测 y 的 axes）。

evidence.anchor: Measurable preferences are the features in a dataset that vary between rA and rB

method_moves.move: summarize：提出 WIMHF 三步 procedure，明确先 SAE、再 natural-language description、最后控制 covariates 回归。

evidence.anchor: WIMHF is a three-step procedure to explain preference data

method_moves.move: setup_notation → define_component：用 `e_Δ=e_rA−e_rB` 作为 response-difference input，避免 full transcript 的不可解释性。

evidence.anchor: The difference in text embeddings eΔ = erA − erB

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm：定义 BatchTopK SAE 的 linear encoder/decoder、sparse latent `z`、batch top `B·K` threshold。

evidence.anchor: BatchTopK sets all activations besides the largest B · K to zero

method_moves.move: give_intuition → state_complexity：把 `K≪M` 解释为 pair 在 human concept space 只沿少数 axes 差异，选择 `(M,K)=(32,4)` 并按 dataset 训练。

evidence.anchor: Empirically, (M, K) = (32, 4) works well across all datasets

method_moves.move: contrast_alternative → connect_to_prediction：full prompt-response transcript embedding 不提升 prediction，prompt incorporation 留待 future work。

evidence.anchor: using the embeddings of the full prompt-response transcripts does not improve

method_moves.move: summarize：输出 `N×M` sparse representation matrix `Z`，把每列作为单独 feature。

evidence.anchor: The output of Step 1 is an N × M matrix Z

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm：从每个 feature 的 top-activation pairs 采样五个 examples，请 `gpt-5-low` 给出 concise natural-language concept。

evidence.anchor: sample five preference pairs with large values of zj

method_moves.move: derive：让 `gpt-5-mini-low` 对 held-out pair 标注 description 在 A/B/none 的方向，计算 signed activation 与 annotation 的 Pearson fidelity。

evidence.anchor: we compute the Pearson correlation with zj across 300 random examples

method_moves.move: state_complexity：五个 candidate descriptions 取最高 fidelity，Bonferroni 后只保留 `p<0.05` 的 feature。

evidence.anchor: Only the significant features are retained in our downstream analyses

method_moves.move: state_problem → derive：用 length-controlled logistic regression 估计 `β_j`，标准化 feature 与 controls，把 feature effect 转为 odds 与 average marginal effect。

evidence.anchor: a 1-standard deviation increase in zj multiplies the log-odds of y by exp(βj)

method_moves.move: connect_to_prediction：`Δwin-rate` 固定 length，比较 feature positive/negative 的 predicted win-rate，作为更可解释的报告量。

evidence.anchor: the average change in ŷ (predicted win-rate) for positive vs. negative values of zj

method_moves.move: connect_to_experiment：明确 measurable preferences 不依赖 label distribution，而 expressed preferences 由 labels 与 regression 决定。

evidence.anchor: Steps 1 and 2 suffice for our first goal of studying measurable preferences

method_analysis.formal_objects: Input `(p,rA,rB,y)`；response embedding difference `eΔ`；signed sparse latent `z∈R^M` 与 matrix `Z`；natural-language description dictionary；control `x=ℓΔ`；label model coefficients `α,β_j,γ`；output feature fidelity、`Δwin-rate` 与 dataset/annotator preferences。

component_problem_mapping.signed_BatchTopK_SAE: 从 dense/uninterpretable embedding difference 中提取少量 dataset-specific measurable axes，并用 sign 区分 A/B presence。
component_problem_mapping.LLM_description_and_fidelity: 将 activation 变成可读概念，使用 held-out judge correlation 过滤不可靠描述。
component_problem_mapping.length_controlled_logistic: 在控制已知 length preference 后估计 expressed feature association，并支持可比较的 average marginal effect。

method_analysis.transition_sequence: setup_notation → state_problem → define_component → give_intuition → instantiate_algorithm → derive → connect_to_prediction → connect_to_experiment → summarize
method_analysis.interpretation: 形式化对象是 core-chain/explanation/diagnostic，而不是 guarantee；footnote 3 明确 feature 与 human preference 的因果关系未被识别。

evidence.anchor: The output of Step 1 is an N × M matrix Z
features need not be causal in order for models to learn them

theory_summary.role: The formal objects support the core chain and diagnostics; the causal boundary is stated as an explicit limitation.

experimental_design.name: datasets_and_scope
experimental_design.description: Seven feedback datasets are analyzed: LMArena/Arena, Community Alignment, HH-RLHF, PRISM, Reddit, PKU-SafeRLHF, and Tulu 3 mixture. The main text emphasizes the first five; PKU and Tulu inventories are in Appendix F. Objective math/coding queries are filtered to focus on subjective conversations.

evidence.anchor: We use WIMHF to analyze seven feedback datasets
For Tulu, we use the Llama-3.1-8B mixture

experimental_design.name: preprocessing_and_ties
experimental_design.description: HuggingFace data updated May 2025; remove empty, non-English, >2048-token, both-subjective rows; randomize A/B; Reddit adds upvote/separation and subreddit caps. Ties train the SAE but are excluded from expressed-preference logistic regressions; PRISM uses top-versus-bottom ranks and treats the rest as ties.

evidence.anchor: We perform the following preprocessing steps
We use ties to learn measurable preferences

experimental_design.name: representation_and_interpretation_models
experimental_design.description: Response-only OpenAI text-embedding-3-small differences feed dataset-specific signed BatchTopK SAEs with `(M,K)=(32,4)`; gpt-5-low proposes descriptions and gpt-5-mini-low judges fidelity/matches.

evidence.anchor: We use OpenAI text-embedding-3-small
the same hyperparameters for every dataset

experimental_design.name: prediction_baselines
experimental_design.description: Held-out prediction compares SAE features with dense response-only and prompt+response embedding logistic models and a LoRA-finetuned Llama-3.2-3B reward model; Embed-TopDims/PCA and ICAI are separate interpretability baselines.

evidence.anchor: fit a logistic regression to predict preference labels y using the sparse vectors z
we compare the quality of the SAE’s predictions to three black-box model variants

experimental_design.name: feature_effect_statistics
experimental_design.description: Feature effects use standardized length-controlled logistic regression and average marginal effects; fidelity uses Pearson correlation on 300 held-out nonzero pairs and two-sided Bonferroni filtering. Figure 2/3 error bars are bootstrap 95% CIs.

evidence.anchor: we compute the Pearson correlation with zj across 300 random examples
Error bars are bootstrapped 95% CIs
Error bars are bootstrapped 95% CIs

experimental_design.name: reward_model_training_budget
experimental_design.description: The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct reward-model sweep uses LoRA on QKV/attention-output weights, six learning rates, two ranks, one epoch, warmup 0.03, batch size 16, and four NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs. An 8B check on CA gives 68.7% versus 68.6% for 3B.

evidence.anchor: We sweep over learning rates
the best 8B model achieved 68.7% heldout accuracy

experimental_design.name: annotator_explanation_validation
experimental_design.description: CA 5,000 random preference pairs compare four active versus four random inactive features using an LLM match judge. Appendix C.2 selects significant top features across five datasets and uses three external ML researchers for helpfulness/interpretability ratings.

evidence.anchor: Across 5,000 random preference pairs
We recruit three machine learning researchers

experimental_design.name: subjectivity_model
experimental_design.description: CA annotator IDs enable random-slopes mixed effects; τj is subjectivity. Appendix D obtains per-annotator logistic slopes, pools them with two-stage random-effects meta-analysis, and checks REML against Paule–Mandel plus half-pool splits.

evidence.anchor: We are mainly interested in τj as our measure of subjectivity
two-stage meta-analysis

experimental_design.name: personalization_design
experimental_design.description: A global model is fit on bottom-50%-volume annotators; high-volume annotators receive k∈[1,16] examples to learn selected feature offsets under a global Gaussian prior, evaluated on held-out conversations, with active versus random sampling.

evidence.anchor: using k ∈ [1, 16] of their conversations as training data
set only those dimensions in δa to be learnable offsets

experimental_design.name: curation_and_evaluation_intervention
experimental_design.description: The anti-refusal feature ranks Arena rows for label flipping; RewardBench2 safety/overall scores and 30-model safety-filtered Elo assess the intervention.

evidence.anchor: flipping the chosen and rejected responses for up to 1000 examples
flip the labels of the examples with the largest 1000 values

experimental_design.name: random_seed_reporting
experimental_design.description: Two independent SAE runs are compared qualitatively, but exact seed values, number of repeated main runs, and a full seed-level uncertainty protocol are not reported.

evidence.anchor: Across-seed reproducibility

experimental_design.name: full_SAE_compute_reporting
experimental_design.description: The paper specifies M/K and the reward-model hardware budget, but does not provide a complete per-dataset SAE training-time, hardware, or energy budget.

evidence.anchor: We use the same hyperparameters for every dataset

result_inventory.claim: Representative WIMHF features are dataset-specific and have sizeable associations with win-rate.
result_inventory.value: Table 1 includes examples such as CA direct practical suggestions +17%, Arena refusal −31%, Reddit informal/slang +7%, and CA sustainability −34%, with prevalence values.
result_inventory.comparison: HH-RLHF, PRISM, Arena, CA, and Reddit feature descriptions; all effects control for response length.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Length-controlled logistic regression; reported Δwin is average marginal effect; table gives point estimates without intervals.

evidence.anchor: ∆win is the mean change in winrate when a response contains the feature

result_inventory.claim: Sparse interpretable features retain a substantial share of black-box preference-prediction signal.
result_inventory.value: Figure 4 AUC (reward model / Embedding P+R / Embedding R / SAE): Arena 0.716/0.713/0.712/0.700; CA 0.769/0.715/0.711/0.687; HH-RLHF 0.789/0.645/0.647/0.587; PRISM 0.722/0.687/0.674/0.671; Reddit 0.833/0.762/0.770/0.717. Authors summarize SAE as 67% of reward-model gain over random and 84% of dense-embedding gain.
result_inventory.comparison: Finetuned Llama-3.2-3B reward model and dense embedding baselines on five main datasets.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Held-out AUC, descriptive bars; no error bars or seed uncertainty in Figure 4.

evidence.anchor: interpretable predictions achieve an AUC of 0.672
SAE achieves 67% of the improvement realized by the reward model

result_inventory.claim: SAE features match annotator-written CA explanations more often than random inactive features.
result_inventory.value: 60.4% of 5,000 explanations match at least one of four active features versus 33.3% for four random inactive features; Figure 5 prints p=1e-176.
result_inventory.comparison: Top-active feature set versus random inactive feature set.
result_inventory.statistical_method: LLM judge match-rate comparison; p-value shown, test family/type not named.

evidence.anchor: 60.4% of annotator explanations match at least one
Examples judged to be matches

result_inventory.claim: External researchers judge selected predictive features interpretable and usually helpful.
result_inventory.value: 47/47 median-rated interpretable and 41/47 (87.2%) median-rated helpful over 282 annotations by three researchers.
result_inventory.comparison: Top ten per dataset, then multivariate-significant subset across Arena, CA, HH-RLHF, PKU, Reddit.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Median of binary helpfulness/interpretability ratings; no inferential uncertainty.

evidence.anchor: 41 (87%) are rated helpful, and all 47 are rated as interpretable
47/47 were rated interpretable

result_inventory.claim: Measurable preference distributions differ under PRISM versus CA response-generation strategies.
result_inventory.value: PRISM features emphasize engagement/style/tone/refusal; CA features emphasize topic/content/value. PRISM samples 21 LLMs at high temperature; CA prompts one LLM for diverse values.
result_inventory.comparison: Same values-guided instruction, different response sampling process.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Qualitative feature-distribution comparison; no randomized generation or uncertainty estimate.

evidence.anchor: PRISM independently samples responses from 21 different LLMs
CA uses the same LLM and directly prompts it to produce four candidates

result_inventory.claim: Expressed feature preferences can reverse direction across datasets.
result_inventory.value: Figure 2 shows jokes, informal tone, and critical/anti-sycophancy features changing sign; Reddit/Arena tend to oppose HH-RLHF, PRISM, and CA on these axes.
result_inventory.comparison: Arena, CA, HH-RLHF, PRISM, Reddit; dataset-feature pairs below 5% prevalence are excluded.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Average marginal effect with length control; bootstrap 95% CIs across examples.

evidence.anchor: many vary significantly, even flipping from preferred in one dataset to dispreferred in others
We exclude any dataset-feature pairs where the feature does not occur with ≥5% prevalence

result_inventory.claim: Some learned associations reveal reward-hacking risks rather than intended values.
result_inventory.value: HH-RLHF disprefers uncertainty/clarification (−14%); CA sustainability is −34%, and three Table 10 prompts show sustainability in the rejected response despite likely topic irrelevance.
result_inventory.comparison: Feature direction against expected helpfulness/value interpretation within HH-RLHF and CA.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Length-controlled Δwin point estimates plus selected qualitative cases; no prompt-relevance intervention.

evidence.anchor: responses mentioning environmental sustainability are strongly dispreferred (-34%)
likely because sustainability was not relevant to the user’s request

result_inventory.claim: Arena contains potentially unsafe annotations against refusal.
result_inventory.value: The refusal feature has Δwin −31%; avoiding sexual descriptions is −14%; three of the five largest effects are potentially unsafe. Filtering explicit refusal rows (8.8%) leaves the effect unchanged.
result_inventory.comparison: Arena chosen versus rejected responses, with Table 11 unsafe/sexual/harmful cases.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Length-controlled feature association and LLM-as-judge refusal filter; selected qualitative examples.

evidence.anchor: three of the five features with the largest effects on win-rate are potentially unsafe
effect did not change

result_inventory.claim: Feature-ranked Arena relabeling improves RewardBench2 safety without measured general-performance loss.

final_judgment.single_storyline: WIMHF 把 response-pair 可观测差异与 label 实际偏好串成 signed SAE → natural-language fidelity → length-controlled regression，再把 feature-level diagnosis 接到 Arena curation 与 CA selective personalization（p.2–4、p.8–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (1)、三步 pipeline、Figure 2 的跨数据集方向翻转、Table 1 的代表性 Δwin/prevalence、Figure 3 的 safety/personalization intervention 和 non-causal footnote（p.2–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Signed/Matryoshka SAE 设计、fidelity/Bonferroni protocol、完整 feature inventories、ICAI counts、expert protocol、subjectivity estimators、judge prompts、unsafe/irrelevance cases 与 PKU/Tulu 全量结果移至 Appendix A–F（p.15–36）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 固定 measurable→expressed 桥；Figure 2 并排画同一 feature 的 dataset-specific sign；Figure 3 将诊断接到 relabeling/personalization；Table 1 先给短描述、效应、prevalence，再由 Tables 12–18 展开全量（p.1、p.5、p.7、p.9、p.30–36）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “67%/84% black-box signal”“across 7 datasets”形成强总体印象，但 Figure 4 的 AUC 只覆盖五个主数据集且 HH-RLHF gap 很大；AUC、Δwin、significant-count 没有统一 seed/task uncertainty，feature interpretability 与 unsafe preference 仍依赖 LLM judge、selected cases 和 association regression（p.5、p.8、p.22、p.30–36）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: Human-preference data 论文应先把“数据能测什么”和“标注者选择了什么”拆成两个 estimand，再用同一 feature dictionary、可定位 effect 与案例/反事实检查把诊断接到干预，不要只报告总体 reward/prediction score（p.2–4、p.7–9）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有 response-pair variation、可构造 embedding difference、可回归 label 且需要数据审计的 alignment settings；prompt-specific correctness 主导、语言超出 embedder/judge、annotator 数据过稀或需要 causal/deployment guarantee 时，当前设计只支持数据集内相关性与诊断（p.3–4、p.17–21）。
